articles.description: The S&P 500 Index plunged to the verge of a tariff-induced bear market in April, only to quickly rebound after President Trump relented and by late June was hitting repeated records fueled by enthusiasm for all things artificial intelligence. On April 8, it soared to above 50 for the first time since the pandemic and just the second time since the financial crisis as the Trump administration’s sweeping tariff plans gripped the market in fear.
articles.title: The Stock Market’s Wild 2025 Roller-Coaster Ride in Six Charts
